blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Carlo Paalam returned to the ring after a long layoff and came out of his first fight with renewed confidence in his body. The Tokyo Olympics silver medalist defeated India’s Jadumani Mandengbam via a 3-0 split decision Thursday to reach the quarterfinals of the men’s 55-kilogram division at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. But beyond the result, Paalam was pleased with how his body held up through his first competitive bout since his injury layoff. “Sobrang ganda po yung laban namin.
